trail: Quote Investigator reproduces this sentence from Bradbury’s essay, collected in Yestermorrow in 1991. This review confirms that specialist citation, rather than claiming an independent inspection of the original printed page. Source and attribution evidence ↗

QI dates the essay 1982 and cites page 155 of the 1991 collection. It also finds earlier related Bradbury and Frank Herbert references, so the underlying idea’s first speaker remains unsettled. Read the supporting source ↗
